title: Oxford Spires — Bodleian Library, sequence 02
description: Sequence 2024-05-20-bodleian-library-02 of the Oxford Spires dataset (Hesai QT64 lidar at 10 Hz and Alphasense IMU on a handheld rig, 499 s, 689 m outdoors). Trajectories are evaluated against the official ground truth (gt-tum.txt, ICP-registered to a Leica TLS map, in the lidar frame); maps against that TLS map (published as merged-cloud-1cm.e57 for this site).
